title: Restarting your laptop
drDigitalIntro:
Restarting your computer means turning it off and back on again. It is one of the most useful fixes in computing.
• When something is acting strange, a restart often clears the problem.
• Open Settings, find the About or System section, and look for a Restart button.
• When you click Restart, your computer will warn you that unsaved work will be lost — save first if you can.
• The computer goes dark for a moment, then starts up fresh. That's normal.
• Note: restarting is different from Sleep. Sleep saves your work and wakes up quickly. Restart closes everything and starts clean.

playgroundTask.goal: Restart the computer to fix the error

steps.say: Read the error message, then click OK to dismiss it.
Click Settings in the dock to open it.

drDigitalSuccess: You restarted the computer! The error is gone. Remember: when something's wrong, try restarting first.
drDigitalHint: First dismiss the error dialog by clicking OK. Then open Settings from the dock and find the Restart button.
